title.en: Google releases Gemini 1.5 Pro with a million-token context window
title.zhHans: Google 发布 Gemini 1.5 Pro，百万 token 上下文窗口

summary.en: On February 15, 2024, Google released Gemini 1.5 Pro, the first large language model with a 1 million token context window — later expanded to 2 million. This breakthrough allowed the model to process entire codebases, hundred-page documents, and hours of video in a single prompt, achieving a 'needle in a haystack' retrieval accuracy of 99.7% across the full context. It set a new capability frontier that competitors raced to match throughout 2024.
summary.zhHans: 2024 年 2 月 15 日，Google 发布了 Gemini 1.5 Pro，第一个拥有 100 万 token 上下文窗口的大语言模型——后扩展至 200 万。这一突破使模型能在单次提示中处理整个代码库、上百页文档和数小时的视频，在全上下文范围内实现了 99.7% 的"大海捞针"检索准确率。它设定了一个新的能力边界，竞争对手在 2024 年竞相追赶。

narrative.en: Until Gemini 1.5 Pro, LLMs typically processed 4K-128K tokens of context. Google's MoE (Mixture-of-Experts) architecture achieved a 10x+ jump by using a highly efficient attention mechanism. The model could find a sentence buried in 700,000 tokens of Shakespeare, reason across an entire codebase, and analyze hour-long videos. Google's blog demonstrated it processing the transcript of the Apollo 11 moon landing — finding specific mission-critical details buried in thousands of words. The release was initially available to developers via AI Studio and Vertex AI, with consumer rollout later in the year. The 1M+ context window became a competitive battleground: by year-end, Anthropic's Claude could process 200K, Gemini itself offered 2M, and various startups announced context windows of 1M+ tokens. While some questioned whether longer context always meant better reasoning, Gemini 1.5 Pro demonstrated a genuine capability expansion — making possible use cases (analyzing entire legal cases, reviewing full audit trails) that were impractical before.
narrative.zhHans: 在 Gemini 1.5 Pro 之前，LLM 通常处理 4K-128K token 的上下文。Google 的 MoE（混合专家）架构通过使用高效的注意力机制实现了 10 倍以上的跃升。该模型能在 70 万 token 的莎士比亚作品中找出一句话，推理整个代码库，分析长视频。Google 的博客展示了它处理阿波罗 11 号登月转录文本的能力——在数千词中找到特定任务关键细节。该版本最初通过 AI Studio 和 Vertex AI 向开发者开放，消费者版本在当年晚些时候推出。百万以上 token 的上下文窗口成为竞争战场：到年底，Anthropic 的 Claude 可处理 200K，Gemini 自身提供 2M，多家初创公司宣布了百万以上 token 的上下文窗口。虽然有人质疑更长的上下文是否总是意味着更好的推理，但 Gemini 1.5 Pro 展示了一种真正的能力扩展——使以前不切实际的用例（分析整个法律案件、审查完整审计追踪）成为可能。

description.en: 10x+ context window expansion from standard 128K to 1M tokens. 99.7% needle-in-a-haystack accuracy. Enabled entirely new use cases: full-codebase analysis, hundred-page document reasoning, long-form video understanding in a single prompt.
description.zhHans: 上下文窗口从标准的 128K 扩展 10 倍以上至 1M token。99.7% 的大海捞针准确率。开启了全新的用例：整个代码库分析、上百页文档推理、长视频理解——全部在单次提示中完成。

description.en: Triggered industry-wide race to longer context windows. By end of 2024, every major AI lab was competing on context length as a key capability metric alongside reasoning and multimodality.
description.zhHans: 触发了全行业对更长上下文窗口的竞赛。到 2024 年底，每个主要 AI 实验室都将上下文长度与推理和多模态并列为关键能力指标。

text.en: Google released Gemini 1.5 Pro on February 15, 2024 with a 1 million token context window, later expanded to 2 million tokens.
text.zhHans: Google 于 2024 年 2 月 15 日发布 Gemini 1.5 Pro，拥有 100 万 token 上下文窗口，后扩展至 200 万。

sources.quote: Gemini 1.5 Pro delivers dramatically enhanced performance, with a breakthrough in context-window length — up to 1 million tokens consistently.
